questions.q: What three methods does a class implementing Database.Batchable<sObject> need to provide?
questions.explain: Database.Batchable<sObject> requires start (collects the records), execute (does the per-chunk work), and finish (runs once after all chunks complete).

questions.q: What is the default number of records passed to each call of execute in Batch Apex?
questions.explain: Batch Apex processes records in chunks of 200 by default. That default can be overridden with a second argument to Database.executeBatch, up to a maximum of 2,000 when start returns a Database.QueryLocator.

questions.q: A batch job processes 1,000 records at the default chunk size, and the third chunk's execute call throws an unhandled exception. What happens?
options: The entire job is aborted immediately and none of the five chunks' changes are kept
Only the third chunk's changes roll back; the already-committed first and second chunks stay committed, and the fourth and fifth chunks still run
The whole job silently restarts from the first chunk
All five chunks share one transaction, so this scenario is impossible
questions.explain: Each call to execute is its own separate transaction. An unhandled exception in one chunk only rolls back that chunk — earlier committed chunks stay committed, and later chunks still run.

questions.q: What does start return in a Batch Apex class?
options: A Database.QueryLocator or an Iterable of the records to process
A List<AsyncApexJob> representing the job's progress
The chunk size that execute should use
Nothing — start is a void method with no return value
questions.explain: start runs once and returns either a Database.QueryLocator (built from a SOQL query) or an Iterable<sObject>, giving the batch framework the full set of records to process across chunks.

questions.q: When start returns a Database.QueryLocator, what job-wide limit applies regardless of chunk size?
options: The total records that QueryLocator can retrieve across the whole job is capped at 10,000
The job can only run once per calendar day
finish cannot run more than once
No records at all can be updated inside execute
questions.explain: Unlike per-chunk limits that reset with each execute transaction, the total number of records a QueryLocator-based start can retrieve across the entire batch job is capped at 10,000 — a job-wide limit.
